item.title: [Malayalam] [OTT Release] Eyes
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageMalayalam
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date09 Oct 2026

The series follows Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigating disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating. The show explores obsession, vulnerability and the increasingly blurred boundaries between affection, control and fear.

item.title: [Malayalam] [OTT Release] Khalifa Part 1
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageMalayalam
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date09 Oct 2026 (OTT)

Khalifa - The Bloodline is an upcoming Malayalam action thriller. The first part, titled 'The Intro', delves into the violent history of Mambarakkal Ahmed Ali, the grandfather of Aamir Ali. It chronicles his rise to power and dominance in the underworld, laying the foundation for the Mambarakkal family's empire, which is deeply involved in gold smuggling across several countries.
